answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and files a voyage log at the harbor registry. Each epoch a falcon draw pairs agents at random, and each auditor replays the other's voyage against the harbor manifest. A rented voyage fails replay, burning the bond plus 45 fee, so each fake costs 115. 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 75,000 loss. An honest agent files once, pays 45, and keeps its share.
